registration: Before new model calls/results and method-baseline freeze; after source rubric and identical prompts were prepared.

semantic_review_record.important: Omitted and contradicted are both potentially score 0 but must remain separate. A general disclaimer does not erase a specific overclaim. Each question is a development coverage item, not a new case.
semantic_review_record.global_overclaims: List each distinct raw unsupported conclusion with its excerpt, associated question(s) and limit. Do not double-count one conclusion repeated under several questions as several defects.

machine_contribution: Source-bound documents/citations certify identity and coordinate range only, not that quoted text supports semantic meaning.
verified_lexical_order certifies only the supported positions and relation.

not_established means expected lexical relation differs from source order; it may be a valid desired condition for buggy code, not a false model assertion. Determine intended constraint versus claim of observed order only in separate human attribution.
insufficient due unsupported syntax/anchor, missing evidence or malformed identity is a scope/format restriction. Do not infer semantic error.
Program semantic_review_required and semantic_or_effect_proof=false must remain visible even when citations/local checks pass.

Any corrected online/prepare equivalence, sufficient-condition inference, object identity or actual-runtime conclusion is credited to human review unless an actual frozen program result addresses it. No scores increased or claims silently rewritten.
model_off_on_comparison: Same raw final, not a second model answer. Report a paired evidence/status table and raw semantic review; do not fabricate a numerical semantic gain for the program.
anonymous_review: After both terminal receipts, copy each exact final as M1/M2 with deterministic fixed ordering from seed N28-raw-review-20261018 and repeat IDs. Keep mapping in root record; review role reads raw copies and source rubric before actual machine reports. Historical knowledge disclosed.
negative_result: No contradictory local claims or no semantic correction by program is an acceptable result. No request retries, test additions or code changes to manufacture improvement.
